description: Two light gray tombstones stand on a patch of brown earth. The larger tombstone has an elaborate ogee top with corners that curl upwards. The smaller stone has a simple oval top and is about half the height of the larger stone. Two dark, bare trees stand in the background in front of a purple hill and a softly shaded pink and blue sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
